# Evostackr
> Independent Software Products & Custom Digital Engineering

Evostackr is an independent software studio building proprietary developer utilities, mobile systems, privacy tools, and delivering custom SaaS, cloud architecture, and Google Play Closed Testing services.

## Core Services & Products
- [Evostackr Homepage](https://evostackr.in/): Software engineering studio, products, and commercial services.
- [Google Play Closed Testing Service](https://evostackr.in/services/google-play-closed-testing): 20 verified opt-in testers for 14 continuous days meeting Google Play Console personal account requirements.
- [EvoEdu Pro](https://evostackr.in/store/evoedu-pro): Institutional school, college, and university management ERP.
- [Products Portfolio](https://evostackr.in/products): SMS Campaign Manager, Fabricate, WhatsApp Past Member Extractor, 24IDChat, TempEmailFree, Pink PDF, CodeVault.

## Engineering Blog & Architectural Blueprints
- [Blog Index](https://evostackr.in/blog): Authoritative technical guides and system design specifications.

### [Enterprise Agentic AI Architecture: Production Blueprint for Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems](https://evostackr.in/blog/agentic-ai-architecture-enterprise-guide)
- **Category**: AI & Machine Learning
- **Published**: 2026-11-03
- **Summary**: Explore the complete production blueprint for enterprise agentic AI systems. Learn how multi-agent topologies, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool execution, and deterministic evaluation loops transform stochastic LLMs into resilient autonomous workflows.

### [Modern Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture: Isolation Models, Database Strategies, and Scalability](https://evostackr.in/blog/multi-tenant-saas-architecture-patterns)
- **Category**: Cloud Architecture
- **Published**: 2026-11-03
- **Summary**: Compare Silo, Pool, and Bridge multi-tenancy models. Learn how to architect database partitioning strategies, implement PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, and prevent noisy-neighbor performance degradation in high-growth enterprise SaaS platforms.

### [Microservices Design Patterns: Architectural Blueprint for Resilient Distributed Systems](https://evostackr.in/blog/microservices-design-patterns-cloud-architecture)
- **Category**: Software Engineering
- **Published**: 2026-11-03
- **Summary**: Discover the essential design patterns for building fault-tolerant microservices. From domain decomposition and the Saga pattern to API gateways, circuit breakers, and distributed tracing, learn how to prevent cascading failures across cloud services.

### [Google Play Closed Testing in 2026: The Complete Guide to the 14-Day Tester Requirement](https://evostackr.in/blog/google-play-closed-testing-complete-guide)
- **Category**: Mobile Engineering
- **Published**: 2026-11-03
- **Summary**: Navigate Google Play’s strict 2026 closed testing policy for personal developer accounts. Learn exact tester recruitment criteria, 14-day opt-in verification rules, production application review guidelines, and how to avoid outright account rejections.

### [Cloud-Native DevOps CI/CD: Building Zero-Downtime Deployment Pipelines with Kubernetes](https://evostackr.in/blog/cloud-native-devops-cicd-pipeline-blueprint)
- **Category**: DevOps & Cloud
- **Published**: 2026-11-03
- **Summary**: Design resilient zero-downtime deployment pipelines for cloud-native software. Master automated unit/integration testing gates, immutable container tagging, ArgoCD GitOps reconciliation, and Kubernetes canary traffic shifting.

### [Enterprise API Integration Patterns: Architecting Resilient Webhooks and Event Synchronization](https://evostackr.in/blog/enterprise-api-integration-patterns-webhooks)
- **Category**: Software Engineering
- **Published**: 2026-11-03
- **Summary**: Master enterprise API integration patterns for mission-critical software. Learn how to architect asynchronous webhook ingestion pipelines, enforce cryptographic HMAC signature verification, guarantee idempotency with Redis keys, and manage dead-letter replays.

### [Component-Driven Development: Architecting Scalable Design Systems from Atoms to Applications](https://evostackr.in/blog/component-driven-development-design-systems)
- **Category**: Frontend Architecture
- **Published**: 2026-11-03
- **Summary**: Transform your frontend engineering workflow with Component-Driven Development (CDD). Learn how to structure design token taxonomies, isolate presentation from business logic, enforce strict UI geometry invariants, and accelerate delivery using automated UI builders like Fabricate.

### [High-Throughput Messaging Infrastructure: Designing Reliable Bulk Delivery Systems](https://evostackr.in/blog/high-throughput-messaging-infrastructure-architecture)
- **Category**: Cloud Architecture
- **Published**: 2026-11-03
- **Summary**: Explore the internal architecture of high-throughput messaging platforms. Learn how to interface with SMPP carrier links, partition distributed queues with Kafka and Redis, handle regulatory DND compliance, and process millions of delivery receipts asynchronously.
